title: How do Visual Attributes Influence Web Agents? A Comprehensive Evaluation of User Interface Design Factors

bias_targets.methodology: Modifying the CSS to alter the position (e.g., banner, header, sidebar) and order (e.g., middle, last) of target items on real-world webpages, and measuring the resulting impact on the agent's Target Click Rate (TCR) and Target Mention Rate (TMR).

Generating content-preserving webpage variants by changing visual attributes like background color contrast, item card size, font styling, text color, and visual clarity, then evaluating how these presentation changes attract or distract the agent's clicks and chain-of-thought reasoning.
